# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-06 from the 2026-11-06 Hub dump.

- 3,215,753 models tracked, 920,301 declare a base model, 953,549 parent links, 91,028 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
